_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 60: 21-28 April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why he is seeing it, says he sees 9/11 in this timeframe, tells them to pray over the next couple of months naming May, June, July, August and September, calls it a five month window, then says it is not even that because it is September the 11th.
mentions.quote: It's a five-month window. May, June, July, August, September
mentions.falsify_match: A major attack in that five month span.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing in five months. He widens to five months and then narrows back to a single date in the same passage, which keeps both readings available.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they truly realised how close the coming of the Lord is it would not be church as usual but church unusual, and that from April 1st the birthing pains are accelerating and it is rice paper thin.
mentions.quote: from April 1st, the birthing pains are accelerating and it is so rice paper thin
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: rice paper thin has no measure and the pains only increase by definition.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be a day when every one of the holidays is the last, naming the last Christmas, the last Fourth of July, the last Memorial Day, the last Easter and the last Thanksgiving on this earth.
mentions.quote: the last Christmas the last fourth of July the last Memorial Day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: true of any generation and any year, with no date attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says everything is about to change, that everything they know will change within a twenty four hour period, and asks whether they remember how 9/11 changed everything so quickly, correcting himself on the year.
mentions.quote: Everything that you know it will change within a 24-hour period
mentions.falsify_match: A single day that changes everything.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. In February this was already happening and ongoing; here it is about to happen. Both readings stay live.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the day, that on July the 6th of 2014 he was taken out of his body and the Lord Jesus Christ came into his room and took him to the tribulation, and that it was one of the most life-changing experiences he has had and shook him.
mentions.quote: I was taken out of my body and the Lord came in my room
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private experience twelve years ago, outside this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are planning to take your freedoms in various places for the digital age, the digital currency and digital everything, and asks them to show the new man taking over.
mentions.quote: they're planning to take your freedoms for the digital age, the digital currency
mentions.falsify_match: Digital currency and identity systems replacing existing freedoms.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Who they are is not specified.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said that if you ride the wave of doing certain things, adds that this is not financial advice and he is not a financial adviser, and says to pray about what God has told them to do and do whatever he tells them.
mentions.quote: not financial advice. I'm not a financial adviser
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the disclaimer is worth recording: he gives asset guidance and disclaims it in the same breath.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he is knocking on the door of their heart asking whether they will let him in, tells them not to turn him away because tonight is their night to repent and come to the father before it is too late, and notes no man knows the day or the hour.
mentions.quote: Tonight's your night to repent and turn and come to the father
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to pray and get in the river and see if the Lord has anything for them tonight, and introduces what happened in the last video as the vision the Lord gave them.
mentions.quote: we're going to get in the river and see if the Lord has anything
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth having: the material is sought during the broadcast rather than brought to it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of weather and a major storm trying to come soon, says this is a very clear vision which means it is quick, and tells anyone living in that area to use their authority over their weather because he sees a major storm trying to come.
mentions.quote: This is very clear vision. That means it's quick
mentions.falsify_match: A major storm in the area within days.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Worth recording the interpretive rule he supplies: clarity of the vision indicates nearness of the event.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces what the Lord showed them about solar activity, saying he warned there would be signs as of April 1st to do with the signs of the skies and the heavens, and that he said this was the next phase.
mentions.quote: there would be signs as of April 1st. signs of the heavens
mentions.falsify_match: Notable solar activity from April 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None beyond the ordinary. The sun is near its cycle maximum, so activity is expected regardless.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a woman's uterus with two ovaries and that it says 2030 on the front of the uterus, that it is all in green sludge and floating on it, and that he sees this.
mentions.quote: I see a woman's uterus with two ovaries and it says 2030
mentions.falsify_match: A fertility crisis or reproductive health measure tied to 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He offers no interpretation, and 2030 is the agenda number he has been using since January.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that he is turning things around and that they will have a red wave even in November and will not lose this back over completely.
mentions.quote: we will have a red wave even in November
mentions.falsify_match: Republican gains in November.
mentions.falsify_miss: Losses. This sits against the five consistent tellings that the Senate goes blue, and not lose completely is a softer target than a wave.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of someone who has read the Bible through hundreds of times and says they have to have those people, then asks them to show what the Lord said and when it was, and is told November.
mentions.quote: Show what the Lord said. And when was this? This one was November
mentions.falsify_match: Another on-air replay with the date pinned from the archive.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will not be able to say what they want to say, that he saw a Supreme Court making decisions in the days ahead and could see the dates, that he could see the pressure coming against it, and that he saw 2028 again very strong.
mentions.quote: I saw a Supreme Court making decisions and I saw the dates
mentions.falsify_match: Supreme Court rulings restricting speech.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says he saw the dates and does not give them, which is the recurring gap.

mentions.claim_text: He says these are very strange visions, that he can see from California all the way to the other side and look across the land, and that what is interesting is that each month is painting something.
mentions.quote: I can see from California all the way to the other side
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is another account of the months arriving as a sequence he reads across.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He wonders whether that is for the midterms or for the election, says that when he gets this deep he does not know where he is and has to pull back because it is panning so fast, and that he sees that plague.
mentions.quote: when I get this deep I don't know where I'm at
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a plain statement of why the dates in this material are unreliable: he loses track of where he is in time.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reads the passage about a house of sacrifice, shutting up heaven so there is no rain, commanding the locust to devour the land and sending pestilence, and the condition that if his people humble themselves and pray and seek his face.
mentions.quote: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the scriptural warrant under the drought, locust and pestilence claims.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks why oil rain falls in Russia and reads that oil rain fell there after Ukrainian strikes on Black Sea refineries, that it happened, and that their oil is falling out of the sky and people are touching it and wiping it with their hands.
mentions.quote: Oil rain falls in Russia after Ukraine strikes on Black Sea refineries
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a read-aloud news report of a real event.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He lists Russian oil export strikes by date, naming April the 3rd and then the 4th, 7th, 9th, 14th, 15th, 20th and several on the 21st, and tells them they can read it themselves.
mentions.quote: On April the 3rd, Russia major oil exports
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a list of dated news events read out as a pattern.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of the administration being reached through people who have been there and done that and new people on the inside, and says he saw strategic countries and France that despises the president and has a plan to go inside with some of these others to devise a plan.
mentions.quote: I saw strategic countries France that despises our president
mentions.falsify_match: Documented foreign influence operations inside the administration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. France is named here where the March telling named England, Italy and Germany.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not necessarily support Israel's government but supports the Jews and prays for them because that is what the Lord told him to do, that people need to understand governments come and go, and that Netanyahu's election is this year or next.
mentions.quote: governments come and go
mentions.falsify_match: An Israeli election in that window, which is a matter of public schedule.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The distinction he draws between a people and a government is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the president would be filled with the Holy Ghost and fire, speaking in tongues and controlled by the Holy Spirit, that he takes no counsel from the ungodly, prays over his mind, and covers his children by name.
mentions.quote: filled with, controlled by the Holy Spirit, that he takes no counsel from the ungodly
mentions.falsify_match: A public charismatic conversion.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not happen. Same claim as February, now with the family named individually.

mentions.claim_text: He asks that he would just come back and get them so they do not have to go through another election in 2028, and asks for a supernatural turn of events in the nation and the greatest revival.
mentions.quote: we don't have to go through another election in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The return before the 2028 election.
mentions.falsify_miss: The election happens. Worth noting he asks for it rather than predicting it, unlike the 2028 rapture claims elsewhere.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in 2023 they saw a boat with an explosive device planted in it, that he has brought this up several times because the Lord keeps reminding him of surprise Trojan-like attacks, and that they come when you least expect them and not to underestimate the enemy.
mentions.quote: surprise Trojan-like attacks. When you least expect it
mentions.falsify_match: A concealed explosive attack delivered by vessel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None in three years. When you least expect it removes any possibility of a timing miss.
